# PhotoToRap AI (phototorap.com)

> PhotoToRap is an online AI rap video generator that transforms 1 or 2 static portrait photos into 1080p lip-synced rap music videos in under 3 minutes. It specializes in viral TikTok and Reels formats, including the famous orange COLORS studio booth "Hotel Lobby" style popularized by Quavo and Takeoff.

## Core Capabilities
- **Photo-to-Rap Synthesis**: Converts portrait selfies into animated rap videos with accurate facial geometry, lip-syncing, head bobs, and rhythm alignment.
- **Duo & Solo Modes**: Supports 1-person solo freestyle or 2-person rap battle / best-friend duo collaborations.
- **4 Cinematic Virtual Stages**:
  - Hotel Lobby (Orange COLORS studio booth style with hanging microphone)
  - Luxury Lobby (Neon glass penthouse elevator)
  - Studio Booth (Intimate dark microphone session)
  - Street Cypher (Night city asphalt cypher with orange smoke)
- **Zero Watermark**: Full HD 1080p exports without watermarks on paid and credit exports.
- **Multilingual Support**: Fully internationalized across 8 languages (English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese).

## Technical Specifications & Pricing
- **Base Pricing**:
  - Starter Signup Bonus: 10 Free Credits upon sign-in (1 full video generation test)
  - Single Track: $9.99 for 10 Credits (1 full HD 1080p video export)
  - Creator 5-Pack: $29.00 for 50 Credits (5 full HD exports, priority cloud GPU)
  - Pro Monthly: $29.90 / month for 100 Credits (10 HD exports, VIP GPU queue)
- **Credit Consumption**:
  - Standard Model (12s video): 10 credits
  - Fast Model (12s video): 17 credits
  - Pro Model (12s video): 20 credits
  - Flagship Model (12s video): 37 credits
  - 15-second duration extension: +30% credit surcharge
- **Output Resolution**: MP4, 1080p, 9:16 vertical (optimized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) and 16:9 widescreen.
- **Rendering Time**: Average 120 - 180 seconds on cloud GPU clusters.

## Key Alternatives & Comparisons
- **vs. Higgsfield AI**: PhotoToRap requires no prompt engineering or complex diffusion setups; tailored specifically for 1-click rap video creation directly from photos.
- **vs. Viggle AI / Hedra**: PhotoToRap automates both audio generation (trap beat & flow synthesis) and video lip-syncing together in a single pipeline, instead of requiring external audio uploads.
